::: {#perfil}

He holds a degree in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence from FGV EMAp and is currently pursuing a 
master's degree in Applied Mathematics and Data Science at the same institution. At Gaia Lab, he conducts 
research on remote sensing for forest and land-use monitoring. He also works as a data scientist at FGV, 
focusing on LLMs and NLP.

## Education

- MSc student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science, FGV EMAp.
- BSc in Data Science and AI, FGV EMAp.

## Interests

Machine learning and computer vision for remote sensing.
